name: New G10 Bluetooth Speaker, Mini Mirror Clock, Alarm Clock, Small Speaker, FM Card, Mobile Phone Stand,
description:
Product Name	Alarm Clock Bluetooth Speaker
Material	ABS Plastic
Color Options	Black / White / Pink
Output Power	5W
PMPO	5W
Audio Crossover	Two-Way
Frequency Range	100Hz – 20KHz
Cabinet Material	Plastic
Number of Loudspeaker Enclosures	2
Weight	18KG (bulk weight for MOQ 60PCS)
⚙️ Function & Features

2-in-1 Design: Works as both an alarm clock and Bluetooth speaker

Sound Quality: Clear stereo audio with rich bass

Connectivity: Supports memory card playback for MP3 music

Working Time: 3–4 hours of continuous playtime

Charging Time: 1–2 hours for a full charge

Power Source: Battery, AC, DC (multiple options)

Feature: Built-in clock with alarm function

Support APP: No

Remote Control: No

Display Screen: No

Voice Control: No

Built-in Microphone: No (music playback only)

🔋 Battery & Power

Power Source: Built-in rechargeable battery

Charging Type: Standard USB charging

Charging Time: 1–2 hours

Playback Duration: 3–4 hours (depending on volume and usage)

📦 Package Includes

1 × Alarm Clock Speaker

1 × USB Charging Cable

1 × User Manual
